        WHERE NOT (d2."IsDeleted")
    ) AS s ON d."Id" = s."DocumentId"
    INNER JOIN "Users" AS u ON d."CreatedById" = u."Id"

    LEFT JOIN (

        WHERE NOT (d5."IsDeleted")
    ) AS s1 ON d."SourceDelegationId" = s1."Id"
    WHERE NOT (d."IsDeleted") AND d."Id" = @id
    ORDER BY d."Id", s."DocumentId", s."Id", u."Id", b."Id", e."Id", s0."Id", s1."Id", s1."Id0"
    LIMIT 1

INNER JOIN (
    SELECT d49."Id", d49."AssignedLawyerId", d49."CreatedAt", d49."CreatedById", d49."DelegatedCircuitId", d49."DelegatedCourt", d49."DelegatedCourtNorm", d49."DelegationDate", d49."DelegationText", d49."DepositBookDate", d49."DepositBookNumber", d49."ExternalBranchId", d49."IsExternal", d49."LocalAdditionCount", d49."LocalAdditionLastAt", d49."LocalAdditionLastMessage", d49."RedirectedToSectionId", d49."RejectReason", d49."ReturnDate", d49."SaleCoversFullDebt", d49."SourceDocumentId", d49."Status", d49."UpdatedAt", d49."Version", b0."Id" AS "Id0", b0."Address", b0."Code", b0."CreatedAt" AS "CreatedAt0", b0."Governorate", b0."IsActive", b0."Name", b0."Phone", b0."Version" AS "Version0", d51."Id" AS "Id1"

    LEFT JOIN "Branches" AS b0 ON d49."ExternalBranchId" = b0."Id"

FROM (
    SELECT d."ExecStatus", d."ExecSubStatus", d."IsDraft", 1 AS "Key"
    FROM "Documents" AS d
    WHERE NOT (d."IsDeleted") AND (d."ExecutedStatus" <> 'مشطوب' OR d."ExecutedStatus" IS NULL) AND (d."ExecStatus" <> 'مشطوب' OR d."ExecStatus" IS NULL)

GROUP BY d0."Key"
